f75c84e0-aaf1-4262-9d61-ca4b6f1e672a@nin.why: The 49ers are off to a 2-0 start, outscoring both the Rams and Dolphins by big margins and sitting atop the NFC West. Arizona is a division rival that just lost badly to Seattle, so this is a good chance for San Francisco to build an early cushion in the division standings. It is only week three, so nothing is clinched or lost here, but a win would keep the 49ers unbeaten and add to their divisional tiebreaker edge.
f75c84e0-aaf1-4262-9d61-ca4b6f1e672a@nin.know: A division game means these two teams share the NFC West and play twice a year; those results matter extra later for tiebreakers and who wins the division. Watch running back Christian McCaffrey, who just reached 100 career touchdowns and is a focal point of the offense, and quarterback Brock Purdy, who has been sharp and mistake-free through two games.

75b7b5e8-6b02-4eee-a2ca-0ce91d9bc037@ufc.why: Main event: bantamweight prospect Rosas Jr. ranked No. 12, faces No. 13 Raoni Barcelos, a veteran winner of five straight fights including victories over former UFC bantamweight champ Cody Garbrandt; the winner edges closer to a title shot. Also huge: No. 2-ranked Dumont faces No. 4-ranked Perez, two top contenders fighting for position near champion Kayla Harrison.
75b7b5e8-6b02-4eee-a2ca-0ce91d9bc037@ufc.know: Barcelos already beat two men who now fight each other on tonight's prelims: Ricky Simon and Montel Jackson, extending his win streak. In the UFC, official rankings run from champion down through #1-#15 in each weight class, and beating a ranked opponent is how fighters climb toward a title shot.
